frozen_model.scope: Only triangular corner defects; all main961 images preserved
frozen_model.evaluation_limitation: Weights, threshold, preprocessing and aggregation fixed before142-image V28 regression evaluation. The retained142-image holdout was exposed during earlier development, so results are internal regression, not independent field validation. Model selection and threshold use only the146-image validation split.
frozen_model.reorganization: Model parameter files unchanged. Source entrypoints and data paths moved; full dataset and inference parity checked separately.

primary_preprocessing: Existing Predictor: PIL grayscale L -> bilinear320 -> float32/255
secondary_probe: Predeclared resolution sensitivity only: PIL grayscale L -> bilinear224 -> bilinear320 -> float32/255; never used to select a threshold or replace primary results
review_rule: Inspect generated visual content and lock actual labels before inference. Keep every generated sample. If ambiguous or out of scope, record reason and report separately regardless of model score. Do not regenerate based on classifier output.
scope: Reference-conditioned synthetic robustness batch, not independent real-camera field validation. References come from the training split. Not added to training or used for optimization.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one held-out synthetic machine-vision test photograph, not a collage or report.
Input image role: reference for the original inspection scene, workpiece geometry, material, cropping and defect topology. Generate a fresh capture, not a pixel-identical copy.
Scene: a single matte medium-gray rectangular cuboid workpiece on a dark textured conveyor belt, sometimes a thin metal guide rail at the far border, viewed obliquely from above exactly like the reference crop. Square close crop containing one whole block with a small visible background margin. No other objects.
Style: monochrome grayscale industrial inspection camera photograph, modest contrast, slight sensor noise and soft low-cost camera detail matching the reference. No color. Not a clean studio product render, not a stylized drawing, not a dramatic cinematic photograph.
Required case: Intact rectangular cuboid, three visible straight edges meet at sharp, complete vertices. Neutral medium exposure. Fresh capture, slightly different belt surface grain and block angle.
Constraints: same block proportions and inspection scene as reference; vary pose/lighting only as specified. For any defective case use ONLY one triangular corner truncation at a convex vertex, matching the original reference. A dark painted triangle without missing geometry is not a chip. No holes, cracks, rectangular or U-shaped notches, serrated cuts, multiple chips, exposed white filler, detached chunks, hands, rulers, labels, arrows, text or watermarks. Return one square full-frame photograph.
